lines.text: The root is Dict! Predict, dictate.
Did you know? Dict is Latin for say.
Dictate: say words for someone to write down.
Quick quiz! Which means before plus say?

words.ex: It is hard to predict the weather in the mountains.

words.mean: say words for someone to write down
words.ex: Your budget will dictate where you can stay.
